distinguishing_features: Adds a passive conductive grading/corona ring at the dielectric edge interface to reshape the equipotential field distribution, rather than inferring degradation from existing telemetry.
Physically mitigates local field enhancement (reduces β) at geometric discontinuities instead of monitoring tanδ/Gp via leakage-current phase analysis.
Retrofit mechanical part integrated during assembly, no reliance on dynamic operational signature or temperature normalization.
Targets partial-discharge inception at edges as the failure initiator rather than bushing bulk insulation loss tangent.
parsed.objective_technical_problem: How to reduce localized electric-field concentration at dielectric edge/geometric discontinuities so as to prevent partial discharges and subsequent dielectric breakdown, without merely increasing dielectric volume or thickness.
parsed.viable_reason: Corona/grading rings are a well-established, physically sound technique for field grading at HV electrodes, and the candidate's test protocol (PD inception comparison) is directly executable at the stated scale.
parsed.non_obvious_reason: Neither prior art employs a physical field-grading electrode to homogenize edge fields; the prior art instead monitors telemetry or alters chemistry, so applying a corona ring to internal dielectric edge interfaces is not a routine parameter change of the closest monitoring art.
